scope: Modern unit timelines 1946–present for the 43 Natural Earth admin-0 units of audit regions caribbean and south-america (ABW AIA ATG BHS BJN BLM BRB CUB CUW CYM DMA DOM GRD HTI JAM KNA LCA MAF MSR PRI SER SXM TCA TTO USG VCT VGB VIR ARG BOL BRA BRI CHL COL ECU FLK GUY PER PRY SPI SUR URY VEN). Researched 2026-10-01: decolonisation (Leeward federal colony, Windward colonies, West Indies Federation 1958–1962, West Indies Associated States 1967–1983, independence dates), the Dutch Caribbean (Territory of Curaçao → Netherlands Antilles 1948 → Kingdom Charter 1954 → Aruba 1986 → dissolution 2010; Surinam → Suriname 1975), French and US territories, Anguilla’s secession 1967–1980, and every Natural Earth disputed area touching these units. De facto control at year end in tier 0; contested areas as tier-1 overlays (0001–0013); editorial decisions, cross-file hand-offs, island assignments the automatic coast rules would get wrong, and known gaps (including Indigenous territories) as note entries (0101–0135). Natural Earth footprints were checked part by part, and the coast rules for uncovered islands were reproduced year by year with the pipeline’s distance function (scripts in .cache/audit/audit-modern-caribbean-south-america/). Wikidata ids verified with wbgetentities/wbsearchentities on 2026-10-01 and all re-checked on 2026-10-02 (second pass: island rules re-measured, the Río de la Plata and Courantyne islands identified, Bolivia/Peru–Chile decision added).
